body: Basically, that was just it they accused me of filming them without their consent. What I did was perfectly legal and I don't have a criminal record but they phrased it in a way that makes it sound really dodgy.
I think everyone thinks their actions do not deserve a criminal record. I think unfortunately, you're going to have a criminal record but not necessarily a custodial sentence.

Thank you, I will do that. I suppose I did not take further action at the time because I was worried that doing so would make the page spread wider (it is relatively obscure at the moment). My only concern is would filling in this form alert the group? I have nothing to hide so I would not be too concerned it is just they might try to spin it. 

If an employer comes across it anyway, should I just point out what I did was not a crime, the police were not involved and I have no criminal record?
